$comment: Known-failing correctness cases: real, reproduced bugs in the tool under test.
They are listed here so `pnpm confirm` can stay a useful gate. A listed
failure does not fail the build; ANY unlisted failure does. Just as
importantly, a listed entry that starts PASSING also fails the build, so a
fixed tool cannot quietly leave a stale suppression behind.
This is not a way to silence inconvenient results. Every entry names the
tool, the observed behaviour, and stays only until the upstream fix lands.
Delete the entry the moment the tool is fixed — the suite will tell you.
compile/v-once/vize: vize emits an unquoted object key in the v-once cache path (`data-testid: "once"`), producing JavaScript that does not parse. Siblings outside v-once quote correctly.
compile/custom-directive/vize: vize omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ flag for user directives, so the element never enters dynamicChildren and the directive's updated hook never fires. It does emit 512 for built-in v-show.
compile/dynamic-slot-name/vize: vize emits `{ [_ctx.slotName]: ... }` instead of `[slotName.value]`, so a setup-binding slot name never resolves at runtime.
compile/v-once/verter: verter ignores v-once entirely — no _cache / _setBlockTracking wrapper is emitted and the subtree re-renders.
compile/v-text-v-html/verter: verter silently drops v-text and v-html: emits _createElementVNode("span", _hoisted_1) with an empty props object, no textContent/innerHTML, and reports no error.
compile/custom-directive/verter: verter compiles a <script setup> local directive to _resolveDirective("highlight") instead of binding vHighlight, so it fails to resolve at runtime.
compile/css-v-bind/verter: verter double-prefixes useCssVars keys (emits "--a91785dd-x" where runtime-dom then prepends another "--"), so <style> v-bind() never resolves.
compile/v-show/verter: verter omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ flag for v-show, so toggling the bound value never updates display.
lint/dupe-else-if/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/duplicate-attributes/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/mutating-props/verter-lint: rule registered in getLintRuleMetadata() as vue-essential but never fires.
lint/mutating-props/vize-lint: no-mutating-props never fires on `props.count += 1` under default, essential, opinionated or ecosystem presets.
lint/deprecated-slot-attr/vize-lint: no-deprecated-slot-attribute never fires on Vue 2 `slot="header"` under any preset.
typecheck/inherit-attrs-false-unknown/ve: verter-tsc unconditionally exempts data-* and aria-* prefixed attributes from strictTemplates undeclared-prop checking (aria-zzz is silent, notdeclared errors), so the planted unknown attribute is missed. Unrelated to inheritAttrs.
typecheck/attrs-aria-data-unknown/verter: Same root cause as above — this case isolates the data-*/aria-* prefix exemption directly.
typecheck/generic-component-ok/verter-ts: verter-tsc emits 3 spurious diagnostics about its own virtual code on a CLEAN generic <script setup> component: ___VERTER___Attrs requires 1 type argument, ___VERTER___attributes is not generic, Cannot find name 'items'.
typecheck/component-ref-expose-bad/vize-: vize does not typecheck defineExpose on a component template ref — hide() on a child that only exposes focus is silent. vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar all report TS2339.
typecheck/missing-required-prop/golar-ty: golar typecheck does not report a missing required child prop (<Child /> where title: string is required). vue-tsc, vize and verter-tsc all do.
typecheck/v-if-discriminant-ok/verter-ts: verter-tsc does not auto-unwrap a ref in a tagged-union v-if (pet.kind): it types pet as Ref<Dog | Cat> and reports Property 'kind' does not exist. vue-tsc, vize and golar unwrap correctly and stay clean.
typecheck/fallthrough-mono-ok/verter-tsc: verter-tsc does not honour vueCompilerOptions.fallthroughAttributes: a native id on a single-root inheritAttrs-default child is reported as an extra prop (TS2353). vue-tsc and golar accept the fallthrough.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-both-mono-ok/v: Same as fallthrough-mono-ok/verter-tsc — v-if/v-else both single-root is still treated as an unknown id.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-static-ok/vert: Same as fallthrough-mono-ok/verter-tsc — statically true v-if single root still errors on fallthrough id.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-static-prop-ok: Same as fallthrough-mono-ok/verter-tsc — literal-true prop still errors on fallthrough id.
typecheck/fallthrough-mono-false-bad/viz: vize does not reject undeclared attrs under fallthroughAttributes (inheritAttrs:false + single root, id= is silent). Same gap as its missing strict-component-attrs capability, now visible because this family is not skipped.
typecheck/fallthrough-multi-bad/vize-che: vize does not reject undeclared attrs on a multi-root fragment under fallthroughAttributes (id= is silent). vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar all report TS2353.
typecheck/fallthrough-multi-false-bad/vi: vize does not reject undeclared attrs on inheritAttrs:false + multi-root under fallthroughAttributes.
typecheck/fallthrough-native-type-bad/vi: vize does not typecheck fallthrough native attrs: :disabled="'nope'" on a single <button> root is silent. vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar report the string/boolean mismatch.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-both-mono-fals: vize does not reject undeclared id when inheritAttrs is false and both v-if branches are single-root.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-static-multi-b: vize does not reject undeclared id when v-if="true" expands to a fragment.
typecheck/fallthrough-vif-mono-multi-bad: vue-tsc (Volar) treats v-if single-root / v-else fragment as fallthrough-eligible and accepts undeclared id. Runtime is not always one root. verter-tsc reports TS2353. A Volar gap, not a plant bug.
golar matches Volar here: v-if mono / v-else multi is treated as a single fallthrough target. verter-tsc reports the extra id.
vize is silent on undeclared id for v-if mono / v-else multi (same missing fallthrough/attr check as its other fallthrough misses).
typecheck/generic-default-ok/verter-tsc: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc: ___VERTER___attributes is not generic on a CLEAN generic SFC.
typecheck/generic-emit-ok/verter-tsc: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc on a CLEAN generic + defineEmits SFC.
typecheck/generic-fallthrough-mono-ok/ve: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc on a CLEAN generic single-root SFC.
typecheck/generic-inherit-false-class-ok: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc on a CLEAN generic + inheritAttrs:false SFC.
typecheck/generic-multi-root-ok/verter-t: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc on a CLEAN generic multi-root SFC.
typecheck/generic-slot-ok/verter-tsc: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc on a CLEAN generic + defineSlots SFC.
typecheck/generic-two-params-ok/verter-t: Same virtual-code leak as generic-component-ok/verter-tsc: ___VERTER___Attrs requires 2 type arguments on a CLEAN two-param generic SFC.
typecheck/generic-slot-bad/vize-check: vize does not typecheck a generic scoped-slot payload (item.id number passed to a string-only fn is silent). vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar report the mismatch.
typecheck/generic-two-params-bad/vize-ch: vize does not typecheck a two-param generic slot payload (inferred number vs string-only consumer is silent).
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-ok/vize: vize types defineModel as a single Ref, not the [model, modifiers] tuple, so `const [model, modifiers] = defineModel<string, 'trim' | 'capitalize'>()` is TS2488 (Ref is not iterable). vue-tsc and golar accept the tuple and the v-model.trim call site.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-ok/vert: verter-tsc does not type defineModel modifiers at the call site: v-model.trim on a string model is reported as extra props on the child (TS2322) rather than accepted. vue-tsc and golar stay clean.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-read-ba: Same defineModel-as-Ref gap as define-model-modifiers-ok/vize-check: the tuple destructure is TS2488, so modifiers.nope is never checked. vue-tsc and golar report TS2339 on nope.

verter-tsc emits a virtual-code leak (Generic type 'Prettify' requires 1 type argument) on defineModel<string, 'trim' | 'capitalize'> and never reports modifiers.nope. vue-tsc and golar report TS2339.
typecheck/define-model-modifiers-unknown: Same defineModel-as-Ref gap: the child tuple is TS2488 and v-model.nope is not reported. vue-tsc and golar report TS2353 on the unknown modifier.
typecheck/define-model-named-modifiers-o: Same defineModel-as-Ref gap on a named model: `const [title, modifiers] = defineModel<string, 'trim'>('title')` is TS2488. vue-tsc and golar stay clean.
Same as define-model-modifiers-ok/verter-tsc — v-model:title.trim is rejected as extra props (TS2322) instead of accepted as a declared modifier.
typecheck/slot-default-implicit-ok/verte: verter-tsc errors on a CLEAN implicit default <slot />: Property '$slots' does not exist on the generated component type. vue-tsc, vize and golar stay clean.
typecheck/slot-provide-type-bad/vize-che: vize does not typecheck props passed into <slot> against defineSlots ( :msg="1" where msg: string is silent). vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar report TS2322.
typecheck/slot-unknown-prop-bad/vize-che: vize does not typecheck scoped-slot destructure extras ({ missing } on a { msg: string } payload is silent). vue-tsc, verter-tsc and golar report TS2339.
typecheck/slot-v-bind-bad/vize-check: vize does not typecheck <slot v-bind> against defineSlots (item.id: string vs number is silent). vue-tsc and golar report the mismatch.
typecheck/slot-v-bind-bad/verter-tsc: verter-tsc does not type <slot v-bind="obj"> as the slot payload: it reports TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 0 instead of the id string/number mismatch. vue-tsc and golar report the payload mismatch.
typecheck/slot-v-bind-ok/verter-tsc: Same <slot v-bind> hole as slot-v-bind-bad/verter-tsc on a CLEAN fixture: TS2554 Expected 1 arguments, but got 0. vue-tsc, vize and golar stay clean.
component-meta/generic-props/vize-declar: vize generateDeclaration emits unparseable TypeScript for generic components — `export type Props<T extends { id: number } = any> = <{ ... }>;` wraps the body in angle brackets (3 TS parse errors). Only generic components are affected.
compile/v-for-list/fervid: fervid emits double-parenthesised arrow parameters for multi-binding v-for — _renderList(__props.items, ((item, index))=>...) — which is not valid JavaScript, so the module fails to parse. Single-binding v-for (v-for="item in items") is unaffected. This is the same defect that fails the compile surface codegen validity gate on 22/200 timed fixtures.
compile/slot-fallback/fervid: fervid passes slot fallback content to _renderSlot as an ARRAY — _renderSlot(_ctx.$slots, "default", {}, [_createTextVNode("fallback")]) — where Vue's renderSlot requires a thunk (() => [...]). Vue calls the argument, so rendering the fallback throws "fallback is not a function".
compile/dynamic-component-is/fervid: fervid compiles <component :is="..."> as an ordinary user component named "component" (_resolveComponent("component") with is passed as a plain prop) instead of Vue's built-in dynamic element (_resolveDynamicComponent). The bound component never renders.
compile/keep-alive/fervid: Same root cause as compile/dynamic-component-is/fervid: the <component :is> inside <KeepAlive> is compiled as a literal "component" component, so the counter never mounts and no state survives to be kept alive. The _KeepAlive wrapper itself is emitted correctly.
compile/custom-directive/fervid: fervid binds the <script setup> local directive correctly (vHighlight, not _resolveDirective) but omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ patch flag on the element, so it never enters dynamicChildren and the directive's updated hook never fires. Same flag omission as the documented vize and verter cases.
compile/dynamic-slot-name/fervid: fervid emits a dynamic slot as a plain computed key on a static slots object — { [slotName.value]: _withCtx(...) } — instead of _createSlots(..., [{ name, fn }]) with the 1024 /* DYNAMIC_SLOTS */ flag. The expression itself is correct (slotName.value, not _ctx.slotName), but without the dynamic-slots marker the child is not re-rendered when the slot name changes, so the content stays on the original slot.
compile/event-modifiers/fervid: fervid compiles the KEY modifier @keyup.enter as an EVENT modifier — _withModifiers(handler, ["enter"]) instead of _withKeys(handler, ["enter"]). withModifiers does not recognise "enter", so the guard is a no-op and the handler fires on every keyup rather than only on Enter. .stop and .prevent are compiled correctly.
compile/css-v-bind/fervid: fervid sets __scopeId but emits no useCssVars() call in setup(), so a <style> v-bind(themeColor) never injects its CSS custom property and the bound value is never applied.
compile/v-show/fervid: fervid emits the v-show directive binding correctly (_withDirectives with _vShow) but omits the 512 /* NEED_PATCH */ patch flag, so toggling the bound value never updates display. Same root cause as compile/custom-directive/fervid and the documented verter case.
lsp/hover-template-binding/vize: Vize hover on a script-setup const inside {{ }} returns generic binding prose (`Binding from <script setup>`, auto-unwrap notes) with no TypeScript type. Volar answers `(property) greeting: "confirm-lsp"` and Verter `const greeting: "confirm-lsp"`.
